title: The False Heir
summary: In the climax of the Seoul siege, Void General Xal'Khor claims Ha-Jun is an illegitimate vessel destined to be consumed. Ha-Jun unleashes the full might of the Ten Relics, obliterating the Void vanguard.

panels.shot: xal'khor rising from the smoking asphalt crater wide shot
panels.action: Xal'Khor climbs out of the rubble, green coolant leaking from cracked chassis seams, sparks flying.

panels.shot: xal'khor mirrored visor cracking open to reveal void eye
panels.action: The silver visor splits in half, revealing a single swirling eye of pure black cosmic antimatter.

panels.shot: xal'khor laughing in distorted robotic mockery
panels.action: Xal'Khor laughs with grinding digital feedback: 'You think you are the True Sovereign, child?!'

dialogue.speaker: xal_khor
dialogue.text: You are a FALSE HEIR! Tumhare bloodline ko Void Primordial ne intentionally design kiya tha!

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes narrowing in cold focus
panels.action: Ha-Jun hovers unperturbed, the Crown glowing steady: 'Lies of a machine with broken gears.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumhari baatein tumhare weapons se bhi zyada cheap hain.

panels.shot: xal'khor deploying full-scale antimatter cannon
panels.action: Xal'Khor's six arms interlock into a massive 12-foot railgun cannon charged with black-green plasma.

panels.shot: plasma output enough to vaporize gangnam district
panels.action: Thermal sensors on Min-Jae's laptop spike into the gigawatt range: 'HA-JUN! USE STOP KARO! PURA GANGNAM VAPORIZE HO JAYEGA!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: GIGAWATT OUTPUT! IT WILL LEVEL HALF OF SEOUL!!

panels.shot: ha-jun landing softly between the cannon and the city
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches down on the asphalt thirty meters in front of the charged cannon, planting his boots.

panels.shot: ha-jun sheathing both physical weapons
panels.action: Ha-Jun sheathes both the greatsword and the dagger, standing with empty hands at his sides.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Weapons se yeh nahi rukega... Iske liye pure Sovereign Authority chahiye.

panels.shot: ha-jun placing left hand on sovereign chest brand
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his hand against the burning lotus crest on his chest: 'All Relics... Unite into Sovereign Aegis!'

panels.shot: all ten relics projecting physical light constructs around him
panels.action: The ten relics manifest as ten towering 30-foot translucent crystalline shields encircling him.

panels.shot: xal'khor firing the antimatter apocalypse beam
panels.action: The 12-foot cannon discharges: a blinding 20-meter-wide beam of apocalyptic black-green antimatter.

panels.shot: antimatter beam striking the ten-fold sovereign aegis
panels.action: The beam crashes into Ha-Jun's shields; a blinding white sphere of kinetic pressure illuminates all of Seoul.

panels.shot: first three basic relic shields absorbing kinetic force
panels.action: The Bone, Blood, and Heart shields absorb the physical and thermal shockwaves, cooling the plasma.

panels.shot: next three rare relic shields severing spatial cohesion
panels.action: The Fang, Eye, and Chains shields slice the beam's molecular cohesion into scattered harmless sparks.

panels.shot: ha-jun walking forward through the raging beam
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward through the center of the beam, unburned, hair billowing, eyes like blazing suns.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main dhaal hoon... Aur dhaal kabhi nahi tootti.

panels.shot: xal'khor visor fracturing in panic as beam fails
panels.action: Xal'Khor's systems overload as Ha-Jun walks straight toward the muzzle: 'CANNOT COMPUTE! POWER IMMUNITY OVERFLOW!'

panels.shot: ha-jun reaching the cannon muzzle
panels.action: Ha-Jun arrives at the smoking barrel of the cannon, his left bone gauntlet clamping onto the weapon frame.

panels.shot: ha-jun crushing the 12-foot antimatter cannon like tinfoil
panels.action: With a single flex of his bone fingers, the massive titanium cannon collapses into crumpled scrap.

panels.shot: xal'khor stumbling backward in weaponless shock
panels.action: The Void General falls backward onto his hands, stripped of all weapons and defenses.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting eclipse devourer overcharged with absorbed beam
panels.action: Ha-Jun draws the Eclipse Devourer; the blade has absorbed the entire gigawatt antimatter beam.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tumne pucha tha na ki main kaun hoon?

panels.shot: ha-jun voice echoing across the entire continent
panels.action: Ha-Jun speaks with the weight of five thousand years of emperors: 'I am Ha-Jun Kang. The Demon Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: MAIN HA-JUN KANG HOON! THE TRUE DEMON SOVEREIGN!!

panels.shot: vertical downward celestial execution slash
panels.action: Ha-Jun swings the overcharged greatsword down in a clean, absolute vertical guillotine cleave.

panels.shot: xal'khor bisected from crown to chassis
panels.action: Void General Xal'Khor is sliced cleanly down the center; green coolant and void fire erupt from the seam.

panels.shot: colossal 100-foot explosion of green and violet fireworks
panels.action: The Void General's power core detonates in a magnificent, harmless shower of sparkling violet fireworks.

panels.shot: the sky rift above gangnam snapping shut
panels.action: With the general's death, the 300-meter void rift in the clouds snaps shut; stars twinkle over Seoul.

panels.shot: remaining void bio-beasts dissolving into dust
panels.action: Across all of Seoul, the remaining mindless void monsters dissolve into harmless grey ash in the rain.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing in the center of silent gangnam
panels.action: Silence returns to the city; Ha-Jun lowers his blade as the rain softly patters on his dark coat.

panels.shot: citizens and hunters erupting in wild, tearful celebration
panels.action: Thousands of human citizens flood the streets from buildings, cheering and embracing the demon soldiers.

dialogue.text: Seoul bach gaya... Aur ek naya daur shuru hua.

panels.shot: captain baek and min-jae running up to ha-jun smiling
panels.action: Min-Jae leaps into Ha-Jun's arms in an emotional bear hug; Captain Baek salutes proudly.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: We did it, Ha-Jun! The city is safe!

panels.shot: ha-jun smiling up at the stars as arc 6 concludes
panels.action: Ha-Jun smiles warmly at his friends, Crown gleaming gently in the clean morning dawn.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Earth safe hai... Ab Tae-Jun ke sath mil kar Void Primordial ki aakhri jad ko khatam karna hai.
